Frequently Asked Questions
Q: My game crashed! What do I do?
A: Tell me what other mods you're using, as well as your version of the game and what you were doing before the crash.

Q: What units/eras/weaponry are being included?
A: All Universal Century factions, mobile weapons, and ships.

Q: The entire Universal Century?!
A: Yep.

Q: Why haven't you added my favorite custom mobile suit/mobile armor/ship/faction/specific weapon?
A: It takes time to add this stuff. I'm coding all of it myself.

Q: Why is that model not the right one?
A: Models take even longer than coding. The people who make them are volunteers with actual lives outside of modding.

Q: Are there eras?
A: Technically. By researching certain mobile suits or mobile armors, you can access the next level of mobile suit development.

Q: Why aren't all the ships I see in the pictures available in the mod?
A: Because you aren't using New Ship Classes mod. They only work when you use it.

Q: Why are my people starving at the start?
A: Because you're recovering from the One Year War. Also that has been mostly nerfed, so if you're still having trouble with it, that might be your problem.

Q: My portraits are all really small. What's going on?
A: You have the main mod and the standalone portraits enabled. Disable the portrait mod.

Q: I want to play this mod on 1.9!
A: http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1311509030

Q: I hate unit caps!
A: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1337874649

Q: I can't see all the resources!
A: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1595876588

Q: I only want ships or portraits, not the rest of the mod!
A: Check the recommended mods list at the top for the standalone mods.

Q: When is the proton drive/Minovsky drive/Mad Wang being added?
A: No. You.

MOD IN HIATUS - USE MY WORK AS YOU SEE FIT - I WISH YOU ALL THE BEST - BLESS YOUR FAMILIES AND CATS _ NO MORE TIME TO WORK ON THIS, MY CHILD IS YOURS

Use "Expanded Stellaris Traditions" by Girion instead http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=946222466 !

Plentiful Traditions
Game version: 1.9.*

http://i.imgur.com/fVVaDCS.gif

Description
This is a mod that adds a lot of new traditions by the addition of thirteen tradition trees. It's mostly a mod I made for myself, but perhaps some of you enjoy it as well.

As featured on the official [url=https://www.twitch.tv/videos/140044892]Paradox Stellaris Mod Highlight Stream, [url=https://odingaming.com/2017/05/02/stellaris-mod-roundup-may-17/]Odin Gaming, [url=https://twitter.com/StellarisGame/status/936640149395574786]"Mod Friday #3" and by Paradox themselves.

[*]Cybernetics - A tradition tree that focuses on robot productivity, physics, new building, synths and energy production.
[*]Biogenesis - Gene-therapy, locust swarms, food, biology, growth, society and grafting your empire into perfection.
[*]Faith - Spiritualism based tree focused on government attraction and edict bonuses.
[*]Order - Traditions that help to strive in removing chaos from the universe. Ship and FTL speed, false flag attacks, sabotage, voidcraft and engineering.
[*]Aspiration - Tradition tree that has trade, opinion, industry and relations at its core.
[*]Malice - For the more evil and daring empires, lower your opinion with nearby empires to taunt them into a war. Slavery, evil and suffering. Other empires WILL hate you.
[*]Affinity - Xenophiles will welcome this tree a lot. Migration, attraction, leaders and society.
[*]Mutagenesis - Intended for Hiveminds or similar empires. Other living organisms are nothing but building blocks towards the perfection of our collective. Toxic Plague war demand, food and society buildings, habitability, regenerative hulls. A more aggressive approach to altering the genes in favor of the great collective.
[*]Industry - Industrial empires that care about mining, extracting, cargo and raw ingenuity to get things done without wasting effort and materials on too much elegance. If it works, it works. Planetary eruptions, ionized excavations, obital fracking cannons, purification facilities, multiple planetary edicts, an empire wide edict and a new building.
[*]Mysticism - Protecting the core life values through compassion, frugality and modesty, Mysticism is a spiritual/pacifist/ecological tradition tree, that is very close to nature and inner peace, unless severely threatened. New buildings (3 obelisks and a sanctum) to preserve life and to provide unity among the people, a new planetary edict (Sacred Act) and the ability to colonize even the most devastated Tomb worlds as they do deserve redemption.
Kleptocracy - Ruthless groups of entities, that often enforce their will on less capable ones. Business is done more frequent and effective when our business-partners are 'convinced' to do so by any means. New building, energy planetary edict, naval capacity and border size, trade bonuses and offensive capacilities.
Factions - Three new factions, Mystics (Mysticism), Miners (Industry) and Syndicates (Kleptocracy).


[*]NEW! - Experimentalism - A tradition tree solely focused on revealing the secrets (physics) of the universe in a scientific way. For a more pacifist/materialist way of play, where research (physics) is everything.
[*]NEW! - Anguish - War, warfare, damage, military and destruction of anyone and anything that threatens you. Going to war is great!


Planned

[*] More to come!


Compatibility
It works great with other mods, except for other mods that touch the "topbar_traditions_view.gui" file since that file is used to create the tradition UI.

Frequently Asked Questions
Does this work for existing saves?
Yes, as long as they meet the current game version.

Will you add more unique Ascension Perks?
Don't know, there are plenty of other mods for this, but there's a new great perk mod called [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1067631798]Expanded Stellaris Ascension Perks by Girion.

Will you add compatibility with other tradition mods?
Unlikely, but there is a compatibility patch for:

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=910355834&searchtext=additional+traditions]Additional Traditions by Meltup located [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1266809457]here.

26/03/22: Fixed a rare edict-related crash bug: it only affected people using both Exigency and Overpowered Civics but should hopefully be solved now. Reworked Planetary Senate (see image)

As before, if you have a descriptor error check the "spare" version linked here: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2478616574



"Exigency" is a collection of all my old sub-mods: new Civics, Technologies, Flags, Namelists, Policies, Edicts, Buildings for planets and starbases, and a few other little odds and ends.

If you prefer your civics to be even higher impact and even less balanced, check out my [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1351653132]Overpowered Civics mod!



This mod doesn't change any base files so it shouldn't cause any compatibility issues.


New Starbase Buildings

Missile Command: Requires 50 influence and at least one Missile Battery. Adds +30% Hull, +30% Armour, and +15% Weapons Damage

Munitions Bay: Requires 50 influence and at least one Gun Battery. Adds +30% Hull, +30% Armour, +9 tracking and +7.5% Fire Rate

Proving Ground: Requires 150 influence. Adds +30% Ship Build Speed, -12% Ship Build Cost and +3 Shipyard Capacity

Patrol Offices: Requires 150 influence and at least one Hangar Bay. Adds +3% Empire Trade Value, +6 Naval Capacity and +15 Trade Protection

Alloy Forge: Requires Ceramo-Metal Alloys technology. Produces 6 alloys and increases all alloy production in that star system by 20%

Construction Centre: Requires Construction Templates technology. Improves planetary build speed and blocker clear speed. (The Engineering World civic gets access to both Alloy Forges and Construction Centres at game start)

Simulation Servers: Requires Self-Evolving logic technology. Produces consumer goods, reduces docked ship upkeep by 10%, and reduces consumer goods upkeep for all pops in that system by 10%. Modifiers are improved by the new Immersive Simulations and Perfect Simulations technologies

Housing Module: Requires Anti-Gravity Engineering. A module rather than a building, granting 2 housing and 3 amenities to all colonies in the system (3 housing with Imperious Architecture tradition)

Also out there somewhere: rare techs for the mysterious Psi Command and Molecular Forge.

At present these are not gated behind the civics and can be built by anyone subscribed to the Exigency mod.


3 New Origins, 6 New Civics

FORSAKEN EMPIRE
-Origin
Perhaps this nation toyed with forbidden knowledge. Perhaps they angered the one empire in the galaxy that could best them in war. And now this humbled society retains only the tiniest fraction of their former glory.
Gain the Ancient trait: +25% Leader upkeep, -25% leader experience gain, -15% growth speed
+200 leader lifespan, +2 leader level cap, +10% habitability and +10% specialist output
+15% Research Speed
 -5% Happiness, -25% Unity production and -20% growth speed
Access to the Forsaken Recovery biology tech path, allowing you to eventually reduce the penalties
More likely to draw this mod's new technologies

PSIONIC HERITAGE
-Origin
-Must be Spiritualist
Begin the game with the Psionic Theory and Psionic Focus techs already researched.
Start with a Psi Academy building on your planet, producing +1 Psion Job per 25 Pops
You may also find a couple of new psi techs: these techs are available to anyone with the Exigency mod active but you're much more likely to get them with Psionic Heritage.
(Credit to Alfray Stryke for letting me see how he added starting techs in his God-Emperor civic mod. Psionic Heritage was my first civic, back in the day!)

SAPIENT INTERVENTION
-Origin
-Must not be Spiritualist
Begin the game with The Supercomputer relic, and the ability to upgrade it by spending Minor Artifacts, improving its passive and active effects
The Supercomputer (at level 1) passively grants Encryption and Stability bonuses but does of course occupy a relic slot. 
The active effect consumes energy for a stronger version of the buff. Ten year duration, shares cooldown with other relic active effects.
Special event edict once you have a fully upgraded Dyson Sphere. But maybe save your game first...

[*]Auto pop migration: Enabling this automation will automatically resettle unemployed pops to planets that have free jobs at the usual cost. There is also an option for it to resettle to the Synaptic Lathe.

The button will make the selected fleet automatically attack the nearest enemy and/or bombard planets with the bombardment stance selected from the settings. [*]Auto planet destroyer: Enabling this automation will make all planet destroyers automatically destroy the nearest hostile planet that is within a neighboring system.

[*]Auto upgrade megastructures: Enabling this automation will automatically upgrade megastructures (Gigastructures, ACOT, and NSC included).

本 MOD 将群星中大量繁琐、重复的点击操作自动化，让你把精力留给阅读事件和把握关键决策。适配 4.4，是「懒人福音」类 MOD 的集大成者。
• 自动化清单：自动殖民地管理（自动行星决议、自动建造建筑与区划）；自动舰队/陆军合并；自动人口迁移（失业人口自动迁往有空岗的星球，可选迁往突触熔炉）；自动建造巨构（超空间中继、星门、轨道环、戴森群、弧炉、居住站、深空星垒及 Gigastructures 的 3 种框架世界）；自动招募陆军；自动建造前哨站；自动舰队攻击（自动攻击最近敌人并按设定姿态轰炸）；自动陆军入侵（全陆军切进攻姿态，胜算有利时自动入侵，可设为入侵原始人）；自动招募领袖；自动行星毁灭者；自动殖民；自动升级巨构（覆盖 Gigastructures、ACOT、NSC）；自动地形改造；自动升级深空星垒；自动配装恒星基地（支持 NSC）；自动升级/管理恒星基地（每月升级、达上限停止，可批量降级）。
• 操作：以上选项均可在主菜单勾选，游戏中通过快捷键 Y 或专属按钮调用；所有自动化均可单独开关。
• 兼容性：不兼容成就模式；与其他 MOD 完全兼容，但建议置于加载列表最底部（按钮类 UI 优先）；存档兼容，但每次更新后建议重新开关自动化功能。
• 已知问题：自动舰队合并偶发异常；自动舰队攻击偶尔卡住（移动一两格星系即可解除）。
• 本地化：英语，以及巴西葡、法、德、日、韩、波兰、俄、简中、西（多为机器翻译）。
translations.gameplay_zh_current: 多项可开关的自动化功能显著减少后期重复操作，是「懒人福音」类 MOD 的集大成者。
translations.reviews_zh_current: 订阅 2.8 万、收藏 2240。这是一款自动化辅助模组，作者自述可自动处理游戏中繁琐重复的操作，提供自动殖民地管理、自动舰队/陆军合并、自动人口迁移、自动建造巨构、自动征兵、自动建造前哨站、自动舰队攻击等可选自动化项目，玩家可在选项中按需逐一启用或关闭。其中自动建造巨构项目还涵盖超空间中继、星门、轨道环、戴森群、电弧熔炉、居住站与深空堡垒等。作者未提供更多评价信息。

Ancient Cache of Technologies: Secrets of The Shroud is an unofficial submod that adds a new tier of technology to the game. It's at around the same level as Static Light

It revolves around a quest to summon a Shroud Master for your empire. A feat that will grant unlimited power, and endless possibilities. But it won't be easy! You should build as many Void Spheres as possible to support the ludicrous cost of these components. If you're struggling with resource storage, you should build anchorages on sigma or runic starbases.

Keep an eye out for two systems: Celeste and The Golden Archives. They're needed for the mod's event chain so getting them should be a priority.

translations.description_clean:
For Stellaris 2.4.1

This mod expands how vassals work. It adds 9 new types of subject empires for default countries (1 for each ethics + 1 for hives), 9 new types of subject empires for megacorporations (1 for each civic) and 12 new types of subject empires and 3 special subject types available under special conditinos. Each subject empire has its own perks. It also adds a new Policy, available once you finish the Domination tradition tree, that let you tax your subjects' trade, and a Proxy War mechanic.

[url=https://github.com/lpslucasps/ver]Fork me on Github!
[url=https://www.patreon.com/lpslucasps]Fund me on Patreon!

FEATURES

New Types of Subject Empires
In vanilla, there are just two kinds of subject empires available to default countries: Vassals and Protectorates. It doesn't matter if you are a democratic crusader or a hegemonic imperialist, the way you treat your subjects is all the same.

In my opinion, to live under the yoke of an authoritarian-xenophobe empire should be different than to be subservient to an egalitarian-xenophile one. The funny thing is, this is exactly how it works with the Fallen Empires. Why not, then, let the players do something similar? With that in mind, now each ethic has access to an exclusive type of subject empire. After you vassalize an empire, an event letting you transform the bland, generic vassals into custom ones is fired, as seen below.

https://i.imgur.com/sMp0UjL.jpg

Some overlord-subject relations are more predatory than others, others are quite benevolent. Not all types of subjects are advantageous, so think before you choose!

https://i.imgur.com/nv2M7Jw.png

If you play as a Corporation, the rules are a bit different. Instead of Ethics, what matters are the Civics of your empire. Corporate Subjects are also all more diplomatically free (all of them being able to wage war and expand) and can't be integrated under any circumstance.

https://i.imgur.com/h9wJFGJ.png

There are also 3 special subject types, available under certain conditions

https://i.imgur.com/olnhdJO.png

If you want to have as many options available as possible, try using the Feudal Society or Franchising Civics - they give you access to almost all new subject types.

https://i.imgur.com/tNL6w73.png

New Policy: Taxation of Subject Empires

After you complete the Domination tradition tree, you can tax part of your subject empires Trade. There are 4 levels of taxation:

[*]No taxation: It's unfair to burden those that are not fully integrated into our society with duties they have not agreed on. Our Subject Empires won't pay any additional taxes.
[*]Light Taxes: Our subjects enjoy our protection and trade. A small contribution is the least we can ask for in return. We'll tax up to 5% of our Subject Empire's collected Trade Value, slightly displeasing them.
[*]Moderate Taxes: Every member of our empire, even those on its periphery, should contribute to its prosperity. We'll tax up to 10% of our Subject Empire's collected Trade Value, displeasing them.
[*]Heavy Taxes: The good of our citizens should be prioritized over any theoretical rights of our client states. We'll tax up to 20% of our Subject Empire's collected Trade Value, greatly displeasing them.
[*]Burdensome Taxes: A subject has no right other than to serve its master. We'll tax up to 30% of our Subject Empire's collected Trade Value, leaving them enraged.

Those policies are not available to nor affect Gestalt Consciousness empires.

Note: Subjects' taxes cap at 10000 Trade Value.

New mechanic: Proxy War

If you have a Puppet State, you gain access to a new mechanic, called Proxy War. Through an edict, you can make a puppet attack a neighboring country. Valid targets must not be in an alliance with you (e.g.: federation) or be a Fallen Empire.

https://i.imgur.com/WprsUph.jpg

LIMITATIONS AND KNOWN ISSUES

[*]Peacefully acquired vassals (diplo-vassalage, protectorates that become vassals, etc) will take up to a month to fire the event that transforms them into custom subject types.
[*]Some effects (lie the taxes from the "Taxation of Subject Empires" policy) may take up to a month to be applied/removed.
[*]The subject's taxes is not exact. The Trade Value "taxed" is added as a modifier to the capital, in 49 steps that go from 5 to 10000.

Translations
[*]Brazilian Portuguese
[*]Polish (credits: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198827989904/]promantix)
[*]Russian (credits: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/dimuch62]Dimuch62)

FAQ

Is this save-game compatible?
It should be. Do note that any vassal acquired prior to the activation of this mod will take up to a month to be transformed into a custom subject empire.

Is this compatible with petruxa's Cultural Overhaul?
If you want to use both mods together, please, download the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1820403112]Compatibility Patch..

My vassals are useless!
The AI is completely incompetent at everything. To compensante that, they receive a lot of bonuses to stay afloat. Unfortunately, these bonuses are deactivated from players' vassals. This behaviour is hard-coded. If you play on higher difficulties, vassals become a dead-weight. To solve this problem, I recommend using the mod [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1590362799]Dynamic Difficulty. Among its many options, there's one to give player vassals the same bonuses as the AI.

Will the AI use the new subject types?

translations.description_clean:
This is a version of Aru's Ringworld Start mod edited to work properly with 2.3 and beyond.

The included starting systems are:
- Ringworld - Four special habitable sections. Random asteroids and gas giants present in the outer part.
- Damaged Ringworld - As above, with two special and two normal ringworld sections; one damaged seam.
- Destroyed Ringworld - Single special habitable section, 3 repairable ones.
- Super Ringworld - 12 habitable sections (6 normal 6 special).


Because 2.2 declared that ringworlds can't have mining districts, and 2.3 decided that normal districts were also not permitted on ringworlds, the starting planet is a non-standard ringworld section.

You start with the ability to build proto-segments, which are roughly 40% of a real ringworld segment. Once you have Mega Engineering, there's a planetary decision to allow you to convert your starting planet to a normal ringworld section, but be aware that this will cause it to lose any deposits and cannot be done if you currently have any mining/farming/generator proto-segments.

This overrides the districts in common/districts/04_ringworld_districts.txt, and is likely to conflict with anything else that changes those.

translations.description_clean:
THIS MOD IS NO LONGER SUPPORTED
Quick tangent for the people asking for updates - I'm afraid there won't be any more. I find it increasingly hard to get back into Stellaris modding, and I have no ideas on how to fix the majority of the bugs present. Due to this lack of motivation, time and knowledge - the mod is no longer supported for any future Stellaris versions past 4.0. I'm incredibly sorry for the inconvenience and letting you down
The mod itself is basically open source, if you wish to make a compatibility patch, an addon, a rewrite or anything - you have my full blessing






Have you ever thought the amount of resolutions in the game is too underwhelming? Never fear, this mod adds around 50 new resolutions, ranging from simple cultural changes to extending your grip over megastructures!

The mod includes 5 new categories with at least 2-3 new subcategories each! Each category focusing on different aspects of the Galactic Community. The mod also additionally adds a couple new events, buildings, policies and even technologies, alongside traits for you gene-tailoring lovers out there!


https://i.imgur.com/yHPBvvy.png



https://i.imgur.com/DeLiWcv.png



https://i.imgur.com/cTUbz3c.png



https://i.imgur.com/XKEef4u.png




Additional changes and notes

[*] To accomodate for all the new resolutions, all the senate-related timers have been greatly reduced. For example, the recess is only a year-long, and the resolution stays for about 600 days on the floor before being passed
[*] If you want to include a translation from your language, please contact Gordon_CMB#4841 on Discord!
[*] No DLCs are required, but for a greater experience I highly recommend installing Federations and/or Overlord!
[*] The mod should be okay to install mid-save, as I haven't detected any issues when testing


TRANSLATIONS

[*] English - How do I put it...
[*] Russian - Maintained by Gordon_CMB. Completed
[*] Portugese - Maintained by Pisadinha/Berenoy. Completed
[*] German - Not implemented. No translator
[*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3513691177]French - Maintained by Stern. Completed 100%
[*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3281293498]Spanish - Maintained by Ekinox. Completed 100%
[*] Polish - Not implemented. Maintained by Pakucza. WIP
[*] Simplified Chinese - Maintained by sunxyw. Completed
[*] Korean - Not implemented. No translator
[*] Japanese - Not implemented. No translator


Once again, I will be extremely grateful to see if anyone is willing to help out with the translations, I'll credit you as an author! Your services will be appreciated :D

COMPATIBILITY
This mod has the resolutions in separate files compared to vanilla and as such, should be compatible with other mods that add more resolutions. Please be aware that all of the mods have been tested with Resolutions Expanded on top of the mod load order! Depending on the position of your mods, the results may vary. The current mods were tested:

[*]Galactic Community++ - Partially Compatible. Resolutions from both mods work and appear proper, but the Resolutions Expanded resolutions appear without a category 
[*]Superstates - Fully compatible. I mean, I made both mods sooo
[*]Expanded Espionage and Diplomacy - Potential problems. Several reports stating that running this mod and Resolutions Expanded removes certain Custodianship resolutions. It's unclear why but tread carefully
[*]Dawn of the Republic - Potentially fully compatible. Resolutions do not interfere with each other
[*]New Galactic System Ever Universe's version - Fully compatible. Resolutions do not interfere with each other
[*]z Expanded Traits, Civics, Pops, and More - Potentially fully compatible. There was an issue with policies but is now currently resolved


Even then you should still be aware of potential issues when playing with several mods, especially the balancing! While Resolutions Expanded runs fine on itself when installing it onto an existing save game, issues might arise when installing new mods. Be vigilant and always back up your saves to avoid such problems!

That is all, enjoy!
If you find any issues or bugs, please do notify me! I'm still a new modder
The mod will be worked upon, and the final two resolution categories are to be added in future updates, stay tuned!
Also, if you have any issues with balancing or suggestions for additional resolutions, also do let me know, I highly appreciate your feedback :)

translations.description_zh_current: GLE 让每位总督都拥有愿景！适用于群星 4.4+ 版本。与作者的其他领袖 MOD 相比，本 MOD 体量较小，因为没有星球修正的情况下星球治理能做的不多。兼容性：命名空间为 gle，全局标志为 gle_started；编辑了一个原版事件（gray_goo_events.txt）；与成就模式不兼容。功能说明：每位领袖都拥有新的技能特质“方向”——方向代表领袖治理星球时的偏好，可提供对应岗位并提升相关岗位效率，MOD 会进一步扩展该机制。
translations.gameplay_zh_current: 领袖玩法扩展：总督拥有“方向”特质，治理风格更个性化，搭配领袖类 MOD 体验更佳。
translations.reviews_zh_current: 订阅上万、收藏两千余，是总督玩法深化的知名 MOD。本 MOD 为每位总督新增「方向」技能特质，代表其治理星球的偏好，可提供对应岗位并提升岗位效率。
translations.features_zh_current: ["总督新增“方向”技能特质", "提供对应治理岗位", "提升相关岗位效率", "适配 4.4+ 版本"]

translations.reviews_zh_current: 订阅过万，是实用型 Bug 修复 MOD，社区评价正面。

Have vanilla megastructures become too boring for you?
Have you ever wished for (mostly) realistic megastructure concepts to appear in game?
Do you want to be able to ascend to godhood and yet still stay ingame?

This mod adds 29 new megastructures to the game as well as a new Become The Crisis-Path, a new Endgame Crisis with multiple ways of dealing with and various different endings, an alternative BTC-Route to Behemoth Fury, new districts, jobs, ship components, resources,  events, origins and much more!

You will be able to unlock the A Tier Megastructures after having researched the Mega-Engineering technology.
To unlock the Tier D+ Mega- and Hyperstructures, you need to have constructed or repaired either a Galactic Wonders-Megastructure or a Gigastructure if Gigas is installed.

Note: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3307019204]When using Gigastructures and the Machine Age, you should use the Cosmogenesis Compat Patch as well!

Also got a discord now for patch notes & bug reports. If you want to share ideas, ask questions or just chat feel free to join!

translations.title_en: Xenology : Traits Expansion Unofficial - Biological Module (3.14.X)
translations.description_clean:
This mod is no longer maintained, please seek alternatives if possible.
If anyone wants to update this, you have my permission.


Original Description:
This is an UNOFFICIAL update to Devious' Xenology Mod.
If Devious asks me to take this mod down, I will do so.

Check out the original here: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2403756280]Xenology : Traits Expansion Neo.

For Stellaris 3.14.X 'Circinus'

Description
Xenology aims to make every species truly unique, each with its own strengths and weaknesses. Some are natural leaders, and others are born inept and dimwitted. No two alien species are alike. Many traits will even generate special leaders with more specialized bonuses (or maluses), incentivizing the violent conquest or peaceful assimilation of alien races and adding their unique characteristics to your own. Alternatively, you may choose to preserve the purity of your empire to best benefit from the traits of one or very few species. Each trait describes a unique aspect of a species' biology or psychology. There is no boring, linear tier system or confusion between societal tenets and biological attributes.

Leader traits are always guaranteed to spawn on all relevant leaders. This greatly improves both balance and AI performance. In addition, the player won't have to hire and fire a dozen leaders in hopes of generating the one they're looking for.

XTE alters very few vanilla objects for improved compatibility with other mods. There are no additional trait points or picks, and no increased cost of gene-modding (though traits worth more than 3 and less than -3 still require advanced gene-modding to add or remove after game start).


Features
♦ 43 New species traits (biological and lithoid)
• 26 Positive traits
• 17 Negative traits
♦ 50 New leader traits
• Many new leader traits require certain species traits
• Leader generation is usually guaranteed for relevant traits
• New leader traits do not take up a slot
• Traits for Councilors are less efficient the more of them you have


Compatibilty
The only thing XTE overwrites is five (5) modifier tooltips via scripted_modifiers:

num_tech_alternatives_add
BIOLOGICAL_species_trait_points_add
LITHOID_species_trait_points_add
ROBOT_species_trait_points_add
country_megastructure_build_cap_add

These overwrites have ZERO gameplay changes,

If you somehow find a mod that also overwrites the same modifiers, the only thing that will change is that some tooltips may display +0 instead of +0.34. That's it.

If/When PDS changes the above modifiers to have at least two (2) decimals of precision, I'll remove the overwrites.

Slightly more technical stuff in the spoilers.
 The only mod I'm aware of that does anything remotely similar is Gigastructures (which is where I got the idea from) but XTE and GIgas are perfectly compatible as we don't modify the same modifier tooltips 

Load Order
Anywhere. Load XTEU Submods after the main mod.

Frequently Asked Questions
Where can I find the full list of traits and leaders?
[url=https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1EhBBPQ-0Ip29mKmkG68vyRjAdfAdcse5mxUjfoldYUA/edit?usp=sharing]Google Sheet

Does the AI use the new traits?
The only two (2) traits that the AI will not spawn with are Polyploid and Hedonist. Everything else is fair game.

Why are positive traits so expensive?
Most positive traits now generate special leaders, who grant additional bonuses. The trait creation menu doesn't give you the full picture.

Why are negative traits so punishing?

This has always been one of Xenology's most controversial design aspects, but I stand by it for a couple of reasons:

♦ Negative traits are, by the very nature of this game, easy to deal with. Poor farmers? Don't use your pops as farmers, have robots plow the fields. Weak soldiers? Who cares, you plan on doing a pacifist run. The maluses are so insignificant in comparison to researchable bonuses, and the alternatives are so numerous, that it's excessively easy to circumvent the challenges imposed by most traits. Even the AI seems to be able to manage their pops to solve such issues.
♦ Traits are more valuable with Xenology. New positive traits mean new gameplay options, and trading easily circumventable maluses for easily exploitable bonuses would make for very poor balance. There is a reason why vanilla includes a few negative traits. Xenology takes a different approach but still aims to maintain balanced and challenging gameplay.
♦ This is the most important reason, and it involves math: negative traits will give you 1 to 4 trait points to invest in positive ones. However, they will always cost a single trait pick, and there is absolutely no way to increase the number of picks in-game. This means picks are invariably more valuable than points. This is a case of increasing returns: if the negative effects of traits were linearly correlated to their reward in points, it would almost always be more advantageous to take the larger debuff for 3 or 4 trait points, since all traits cost exactly one pick. 


Why can't I add Xenology traits to Syncretic Proles or Nerve-Stapled species?
Enabling it for Proles/Nerve Stapled would lead to the situation described above: Easily circumventable maluses. In the future, I might enable some traits for proles, but no guarantees.

Is Xenology balanced?
I certainly try, but if you have any ideas for balance, feel free to post them at the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/2774388842/4658416565931268330/]Suggestion Board

Is Xenology bug-free?
I'd hope so!
But this mod is mostly complete, so the only bugs should come from Paradox overhauling the game every three months.

Is it achievement-compatible?
Nope! Any mod that modifies the checksum is not achievement compatible.

How long will this be updated?
I'll try to keep this updated until 
A: Devious comes back
B: I get someone else to adopt

translations.description_zh_current: 本 MOD 已停止维护，请尽量寻找替代品（若有人想接手更新，作者已授权）。这是 Devious 的 Xenology MOD 的非官方更新版（原作者要求下架即下架），适配群星 3.14.X。Xenology 的目标是让每个物种真正独一无二、各有优劣：有些天生领袖，有些天生愚钝，没有两个外星物种是一样的。许多特质会生成带更专精加成（或减益）的特殊领袖，激励你征服或和平同化外星种族以获取其独特特性；也可选择保持帝国纯净以享受单一物种特质的最大收益。每个特质描述物种生物或心理的独特一面，没有无聊的线性等级体系。领袖特质保证生成在相关领袖上（大幅改善平衡与 AI 性能，玩家也不用反复雇退十几位领袖碰运气）。特性：43 个新物种特质（生物与石质，26 正 17 负）；50 个新领袖特质（多数需特定物种特质，不占槽位，议员特质越多效率越低）。为兼容性仅微改少量原版对象，无额外特质点与特质选择。

translations.reviews_zh_current: 订阅 1.94 万、收藏 2585。本 MOD 是 Xenology 的非官方更新版，新增物种与领袖特质，让每个物种真正独一无二。

translations.description_clean:
Extra Ship Components NEXT
Overwrites: Special Weapons Types Patch

This is addon for  [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2648658105]Extra Ship Components NEXT that assigns proper turret entities for biological, nanite and psionic weapons added by ESC. It also removes secondary weapon types from those weapons, which were used to patch turret entity issues in ESC-proper.

WARNING: This mod overwrites the following vanilla turret definitions in order to properly assign turret entities to custom weapon types added by Extra Ship Components NEXT:
- small_turret
- medium_turret
- large_turret
- extra_large_turret
- medium_missile_turret

This mod also overwrites the following [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=683230077]New Ship Classes turret definitions:
- titanic_turret

Using this addon when you have mods other than ESC NEXT that add custom weapon types might cause issues such as "no-model-cubes" in place of turrets and/or weapons shooting from the star.

Are you tired with the vanilla star names? Want something with a more military/hard sci-fi feel? Do you too read too much Honor Harrington and wish you could have a Treecat? Do you too look up at the stars and wonder if you can blow up a lot of stuff and be cool and wear a fancy hat?

Features:
7000+ new star names, perfect for playing with a larger galaxy mod!
A collection of interesting names that get you in the mood for a hard sci-fi adventure!
Nothing else because feature creep is bad!

Recommended Mods:
Epic Galaxies (it hasn't been updated in a bit, but it still works as far as I can tell)
Real Space, if you want even fancier star types
Tripod's wonderful AI mod. It isn't actually needed, I just really like it!

Side note:
If anyone can name all the stars that are sci-fi references and where they're from, you'll get a cookie!

PS: NOT ACHIEVEMENT COMPATIBLE
